crossRefs.note: Therefore the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, the Mighty One of Israel, says: “Ah, I will get relief from my adversaries, and…
Listen to me, you stubborn-hearted, who are far from righteousness!
I bring my righteousness near. It is not far off, and my salvation will not wait. I will grant salvation to Zion, my…
I will come with the mighty acts of the Lord Yahweh. I will make mention of your righteousness, even of yours alone.
Your righteousness also, God, reaches to the heavens; you have done great things. God, who is like you?
Surely his salvation is near those who fear him, that glory may dwell in our land.
“Seventy weeks are decreed on your people and on your holy city, to finish disobedience, and to make an end of sins…
Behold, a voice out of the heavens said, “This is my beloved Son, with whom I am well pleased.”
“Don’t think that I came to destroy the law or the prophets. I didn’t come to destroy, but to fulfill.
While he was still speaking, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them. Behold, a voice came out of the cloud, saying…
He who sent me is with me. The Father hasn’t left me alone, for I always do the things that are pleasing to him.”
If you keep my commandments, you will remain in my love; even as I have kept my Father’s commandments, and remain in…
whom God sent to be an atoning sacrifice, through faith in his blood, for a demonstration of his righteousness through…
to demonstrate his righteousness at this present time; that he might himself be just, and the justifier of him who has…
namely, that God was in Christ reconciling the world to himself, not reckoning to them their trespasses, and having…
and be found in him, not having a righteousness of my own, that which is of the law, but that which is through faith in…
I delight to do your will, my God. Yes, your law is within my heart.”
But Jesus, answering, said to him, “Allow it now, for this is the fitting way for us to fulfill all righteousness.”…
“Don’t think that I came to destroy the law or the prophets. I didn’t come to destroy, but to fulfill.
Do we then nullify the law through faith? May it never be! No, we establish the law.
Therefore the law indeed is holy, and the commandment holy, and righteous, and good.
For what the law couldn’t do, in that it was weak through the flesh, God did, sending his own Son in the likeness of…
that the ordinance of the law might be fulfilled in us, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.
For Christ is the fulfillment of the law for righteousness to everyone who believes.
Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law, having become a curse for us. For it is written, “Cursed is everyone who…
Is the law then against the promises of God? Certainly not! For if there had been a law given which could make alive…
But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith,
gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.
“For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel. After those days,” says the Lord; “I will put my…
Everyone who sins also commits lawlessness. Sin is lawlessness.
You know that he was revealed to take away our sins, and no sin is in him.
When he had gone out, Jesus said, “Now the Son of Man has been glorified, and God has been glorified in him.
If God has been glorified in him, God will also glorify him in himself, and he will glorify him immediately.
I glorified you on the earth. I have accomplished the work which you have given me to do.
Now, Father, glorify me with your own self with the glory which I had with you before the world existed.

translations.web: It pleased Yahweh, for his righteousness’ sake, to magnify the law and make it honorable.
translations.bsb: The LORD was pleased, for the sake of His righteousness, to magnify His law and make it glorious.
translations.kjv: The LORD is well pleased for his righteousness' sake; he will magnify the law, and make it honourable.
translations.asv: It pleased Jehovah, for his righteousness' sake, to magnify the law, and make it honorable.
